identity_fix.gap: An empty annotation_id on a new bookmark/highlight allocated a fresh random identity per call, so a caller that lost the first response and retried the same revision_id with the identical command encoded a different entity_key and received COLLISION instead of an exact no-op.
identity_fix.scheme: While building an empty-annotation-id create, the module reads the stable revision_id from the product catalog through reader_revision_get; a retained annotation revision of the same book supplies its annotation identity again. Nothing retained keeps the previous allocation, another entity or book is READER_RC_SOURCE, a different payload stays the revision module's COLLISION.
identity_fix.host_requirement: The host keeps only the stable revision_id; it never has to remember the first response.
